Definition: from G1994; reversion, i.e. morally, revolution:--conversion.
BiblicalUsage: Epistrophe is conversion — a turning — and Paul and Barnabas, passing through Phenice and Samaria, declare the conversion of the Gentiles, and cause great joy unto all the brethren.
TheologicalSignificance: When Gentiles turn to God, the whole church rejoices, and conversion is never a private event.
